'''Memnon Demaratus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In approximately [[3643 BBY]], he was hired by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Starsnow (Senator)|Starsnow]] to retrieve the journal of his [[Starsnow (Jedi)|son]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who had died during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], from the wreckage of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. His team failed in this effort due to the presence of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces. [[Imperial soldier]]s and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] filled the ruins and attacked Demaratus' team. Demaratus escaped with two members of his team and met with a traveling Republic hero and the heroes companion outside of the Temple's entrance. He turned the contract over to them and they were able to recover the journal.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Memnon Demaratus appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] mission "Insult to Injury"
